manifest_schema.purpose: ByteDance TeamRun rehearsal manifest for fixture-only evidence shape validation

title: ByteDance TeamRun fixture-only demo contract
boundaries: This manifest freezes the minimum evidence shape only.
The exporter must not start services, run agent CLIs, call model APIs, upload artifacts, or claim the final recording.
Runtime identifiers in this fixture are labels for evidence shape coverage, not proof that those runtimes executed.

chain.label: Desktop bridge starts Local Edge run fixture
Hub replay records completed fixture chain

evidence_matrix.requirement: IM @Agent or TeamRun start initiates the work.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: evt-remote-001 web.teamrun.start plus TeamRun state teamrun-fixture-001.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Capture Web or IM action screenshot and Hub API export for the real start.

evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: remote_control_manifest.targetId and state.target_id both equal target-local-edge-fixture-001.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real Hub request/export must preserve the selected owner-scoped target_id.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Hub exact-routes to the recorded Desktop/Edge device.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: remote_control_manifest.edgeDeviceId, state.edge_device_id, task.edge_device_id, and evt-remote-002/003 match desktop-edge-device-fixture-001.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real Hub dispatch and replay logs must prove no fallback to another Desktop device.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Desktop bridge starts a Local Edge run and records edge_run_id.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: remote_control_manifest.edgeRunId, task.edge_run_id, evt-remote-004, and evt-remote-006 match edge-run-fixture-001.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real Desktop/Edge logs and Hub state export must show the same edge_run_id.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Local Edge run names the runtime adapter id.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: remote_control_manifest.adapterId, task.adapter_id, evt-remote-004, and evt-remote-005 match codex-fixture-adapter.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real run must show a supported adapter id such as codex, claude-code, or opencode without fallback.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Route, task, and event replay expose the same run chain.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: events include run.agent.route_decision, team.route.decided, agent.dispatch, edge.run.started, run.agent.result, and hub.task.done.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real /state, /events, /tasks, and /assignments exports must replay the chain.
Real screenshot/video must show transcript and evidence inspector surfaces.

evidence_matrix.requirement: Artifact, diff, or preview evidence is captured when available.
evidence_matrix.fixture_evidence: Fixture declares artifact/diff/preview as not_available in the offline package, so absence is explicit instead of silent.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: Real package should include artifact, diff, preview, or an explicit not-applicable note with run context.

evidence_matrix.requirement: FixtureRehearsal and RealTested labels remain clear.
evidence_matrix.real_tested_requirement: RealTested requires real_proof refs, real runtime claims, and no fixture_only/mock_only label.

covered_surfaces: TeamRun route, task, and event fixture list

state.goal: Show the minimum TeamRun route from supervisor to worker using fixture-only evidence.

tasks.summary: Plan and delegate the fixture demo task.

expected_capture_surfaces: Desktop transcript showing supervisor and worker turns
Final package manifest with real runtime and recording claims
screenshot_or_video_rehearsal.honesty_note: No screenshot or video in this fixture proves real runtime execution.

artifact_diff_preview.note: This offline fixture has no generated artifact, diff, or preview. RealTested evidence must include one of those refs or an explicit not-applicable note tied to the run.

next_real_evidence: Replace fixture runtime profiles with real configured Agent Profiles.
Capture Desktop transcript and inspector screenshots.
Export the four Hub TeamRun API responses from the real run.
Run readiness again with the exported evidence and final video path only after recording exists.
